title: Shantanu Maheshwari inspires young creators at Arena Animation’s Perspectives 2026 in Mumbai
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Celebrating 30 years of creative excellence, this year's edition was built around the theme of inspiring the next generation of creative professionals by connecting them with real-world industry perspectives, emerging artificial intelligence (AI) powered creative workflows, emerging technologies and career opportunities within the rapidly evolving AVGC-XR (Animation, Visual Effects, Gaming, Comics and Extended Reality) sector.

Adding to this, The event featured distinguished personalities including Dr. Amit Behl, acclaimed star and television personality, Mr. Shantanu Maheshwari, a versatile star, dancer and performer, Star Aditya Deshmukh, a popular face across Marathi and Hindi entertainment, Mr. Vaibhav More, Director, Designer & Animator who delivered a special session on AI in Animation & VFX, Mr. Vineeth S, Country Manager – Media & Entertainment, Ark Infosolutions, along with Mr. Sandip Weling, Whole-time Director & Chief Business Officer, Global Retail Business, Aptech Limited and Mr. Shajan Samuel, Sr. Vice President & National Sales Head- (Arena Animation), Aptech Limited.

Meanwhile, The day-long event blended industry learning with immersive student experiences through keynote sessions, AI demonstrations, star interactions and talent showcases, reinforcing Arena Animation's commitment to nurturing industry-ready creative professionals.

Notably, Students gained first-hand insights into the evolving creative economy, the growing influence of AI in content creation, emerging industry skill requirements and career opportunities across animation, VFX, gaming, digital design and filmmaking. The star interactions further inspired participants through personal stories of perseverance, career evolution and continuous learning.

As per the latest buzz, Media & Entertainment Skills Council (MESC) collaborated as the Industry Partner and Huion as the Technology Partner for Perspectives 2026. These collaborations underscore Arena Animation's continued focus on building stronger industry-academia linkages, enhancing experiential learning and ensuring students gain exposure to evolving technologies, industry standards and career opportunities shaping India's rapidly growing AVGC-XR ecosystem.

In further updates, Beyond industry interactions, Perspectives 2026 transformed into a vibrant student festival featuring Arena’s Got Talent, Cosplay Ramp Walk, interactive engagement activities, AI showcases and the popular Khau Gully Food Zone, providing students with multiple platforms to celebrate creativity, collaboration and self-expression.

On top of that, The event also highlighted Arena Animation's strategic focus on strengthening industry-academia collaboration, integrating emerging technologies into learning and encouraging original intellectual property creation through initiatives such as Arena Animation Originals. These initiatives reflect the institute's vision of developing globally competitive creative professionals equipped with future-ready skills.

Mr. Sandip Weling, Whole-time Director & Chief Business Officer, Global Retail Business, Aptech Limited, shared, "As Arena Animation celebrates three decades of shaping creative talent, Perspectives has evolved beyond an industry interaction into a platform where inspiration meets opportunity. The creative economy is witnessing rapid transformation with AI, immersive technologies and digital storytelling redefining how content is created. Through Perspectives 2026, we wanted our students to experience these changes first-hand by learning directly from industry leaders, technology experts and creative professionals who are shaping the future. Equally important was giving our students a stage to showcase their own creativity, confidence and passion. At Arena Animation, our endeavour is to create professionals who are not only technically proficient but also innovative, adaptable and globally employable."

title: Kangana Ranaut slams Taapsee Pannu, Rakhi Sawant, Sonu Sood: ‘Mere saman 1% bhi life mein success nahi kama paye ho’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut has issued a clarification that she will not stand criticism from a bunch of names in Bollywood who have not achieved any success in their respective careers. The star was seen in conversation with the paparazzi on Monday, as she hit back at several celebrities who have made comments on her in the past few months.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut hit back at several celebrities who have commented on her. (ANI Photo/Rahul Singh) (Rahul Singh) What Kangana shared Kangana shared, “I see such people every day, whether it is Ashutosh Rana, who says that I bark like a dog; or Sonu Sood, who says that I should learn how to behave. People like Rakhi Sawant, who make all kinds of vulgar comments about my character; and Taapsee Pannu, who keep insulting my parents, my upbringing and my background.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ankur chadha (@bollywoodpapking)

Notably, She went on to add, “I have only one message for these people. Agar mere saman 1% bhi life mein success nahi kama paaye ho toh main aap ka koi bhi gyaan nahi sunungi. All failed, unwanted people abusing me all the time). They just want to latch on to the media, but first become someone like me. Can you? I am not here to listen to you. These hungry people cannot comment on me and I will not listen to them. Enough is enough. Only those who are more successful than me, I will listen to them.”

As per the latest buzz, In the last few days, Kangana reignited her long-running feud with Taapsee Pannu after the latter commented on her upbringing. In now-deleted Instagram Stories, Kangana called Taapsee a “sasti copy” and accused her of “ridiculing” her upbringing and parents.

In further updates, She also criticized Baba Ramdev for questioning her character. Sonu Sood had called her ‘Generation Gutter’ remark “very shameful”, saying young people should be spoken about with respect. Rakhi Sawant also criticized her for saying India got independence in 2014.

On top of that, Kanagan had grabbed headlines a few weeks ago for her comments on the Gen Z and the student protests that took place at Jantar Mantar. She labeled certain young protesters and women as " Generation Gutter ," accusing them of adopting westernized mindsets. Later, Kangana pivoted to praise the Gen Z as India's biggest strength and ambassadors of the country's culture and identity.

title: Hansal Mehta-backed Birds in the Dark to premiere at Busan International Film Festival 2026
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Set in rural Punjab, Birds In The Dark is a narrative Punjabi movie shot in black and white and also featuring dialects of Punjabi, Kashmiri and Urdu. Produced by Reema Kaur for Two Black Squares, and by Hansal Mehta and Sahil Saigal for True Story Films, this intersectional movie takes you through various thematics across gender, caste, and class.

Adding to this, In line with Busan International Movie Festival (BIFF)’s Vision section, Birds In The Dark (Hanere De Panchi) celebrates the independent spirit of Asian cinema, putting a spotlight on bold and personal storytelling of South Asian filmography.

Meanwhile, On the movie’s official selection, Director-Writer-Cinematographer Shashank Walia says, “ Birds in the Dark emerges from the people and returns to them. This movie was born from a desire to understand one another through mutual aid, care, and solidarity. It is in these acts that we discover what connects us, what is worth fighting for, and, ultimately, what sustains us; love."

Notably, Reema Kaur, who also served as the editor for this black and white narrative fiction as well as the Producer, reveals, “This movie is our sincere attempt to portray the quiet, mundane rhythms of everyday life, and the resilience that lives within them. Living alongside the community, listening to their stories, and working with them to bring this story forth, we discovered the power of the collective. It has been a deeply humbling journey.

As per the latest buzz, ”This is my 3rd movie at Busan ( Aligarh and Omerta as Director), and I couldn’t be prouder making my debut as a producer at Busan with Shashank’s exquisitely meditative painting on gender, labour, justice and love,” states Producer Hansal Mehta.

In further updates, "True Story Films has always looked to back distinct, director-driven voices alongside our mainstream work. Birds in the Dark (Hanere De Panchi) belongs on a stage like Busan, and we're proud to bring it there,” adds Producer Sahil Saigal.

On top of that, Founded in 1996, the Busan International Movie Festival is Korea's first movie festival and one of Asia's most significant platforms for new cinema, serving as a cultural bridge between Asian filmmaking and the world.

title: Govinda warns of Rs 100 crores legal action over false marriage and divorce reports; flags deepfakes and AI content
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

The development comes after a series of reports and social media claims surrounding Govinda’s personal life. Following the appearance of his wife Sunita Ahuja at court, reports had surfaced claiming that she had withdrawn her alleged divorce case against the star. Subsequently, rumours emerged alleging that Govinda had secretly married star Rani Swarnkar in a court ceremony. Such claims have as per reports been described as untrue.

Adding to this, According to the public notice issued on Govinda’s behalf, the star has cautioned the public, media organisations, digital platforms and content creators against creating, publishing, uploading, circulating or sharing any false, defamatory, malicious, fabricated or unverified material concerning him or his family.

Meanwhile, The notice also specifically addresses digitally manipulated content. It as per reports includes photographs, videos, audio recordings, morphed images, deepfakes and AI-generated material. According to the notice, no permission has been granted to create, manipulate or use Govinda’s voice, photographs, identity or likeness, particularly in relation to his private or family life, through artificial intelligence or other digital technologies.

Notably, The star has also cited his past experiences and expressed concerns over what he believes could be a deliberate campaign aimed at damaging his public image. The notice warns that legal proceedings could be initiated under applicable provisions relating to defamation, privacy violations, misuse of identity and cybercrime, including provisions under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, and the Information Technology Act, 2000, along with other relevant laws.

As per the latest buzz, As part of the warning, Govinda has as per reports threatened civil claims of up to Rs 100 crores against individuals or entities allegedly responsible for creating or disseminating such content. The notice further states that he may pursue additional legal remedies before the courts, including measures concerning bank accounts, restrictions relating to property transactions and seizure of passports, subject to applicable law.

In further updates, The notice also calls for action against YouTube channels and social media accounts allegedly found to be deliberately publishing or circulating false and misleading information about the star and his family.

On top of that, The latest development comes amid continued public speculation surrounding Govinda’s personal life, with the star now signalling that he intends to take a legal route to address what he considers unauthorised and misleading reporting and digitally manipulated content.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Adding to this, There were speculations that Deepika Padukone would be in the sequel. What did the statement say? The official spokesperson of Deepika states: “All recent reports of Deepika Padukone being a part of Brahmastra 2 or associated with the project in any capacity are untrue.”

Meanwhile, Brahmastra starred Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt. The movie marked the beginning of a big-budget fantasy adventure franchise. Brahmastra follows a Shiva (Ranbir), who sets out on a journey to find the origins of his special powers with Isha (Alia), a woman he falls in love with at first sight.

Notably, The movie, which collected over ₹ 400 crore rupees at the worldwide ticket-window, was one of the major commercial successes of the Hindi movie industry during the pandemic. As per the latest buzz, In a chat with followers in 2023, Ranbir verified that Brahmastra 2 is very much in the development stage. He shared, “So Brahmastra 2 is heavy into writing. We are working on it all the time, it was just last week that Ayan narrated the movie to me. Ayan has gone ten times bigger than part 1, his idea, his thought, the characters. He is working on War 2 right now, so the plan is to finish War 2 by mid next year and we start shooting hopefully by end of next year, or beginning of next to next year. But definitely there's a lot of work which is already happening on the movie in the writing process. ”

In further updates, Ranbir also addressed the criticism that Part 1 received, and shared further, "We have really understood the kind of criticism we got for the movie. What worked for it and what didn't work for it. So we want to put everything into consideration. From the dialogues or people saying that Shiva and Isha's chemistry was somewhere missing... There was a lot of criticism that was constructive so we are taking that into our stride, and trying to understand that and kind of go beyond that."

body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:
Written and directed by Sreeti Mukerji, the young-adult romantic comedy stars Aarushi Bajaj, Ansh Duggal, Bianca Arora and Piyush Khati in lead roles.

Adding to this, The movie introduces four young actors—Aarushi Bajaj, Ansh Duggal, Bianca Arora and Piyush Khati—as they navigate friendship, young love, heartbreak, ambitions and the uncertainties that come with growing up. The cast also includes Kunaal Roy Kapur, Anurag Basu, Neha Dhupia and Anju Alva Naik in pivotal roles.

Meanwhile, "Don't Be Shy is one of our most cherished films, and we're thrilled to finally announce its global streaming premiere," shared Nikhil Madhok, Director and Head of Originals, Prime Video (SVOD) and Amazon MGM Studios India. "This movie introduces four extraordinary new actors—Aarushi, Ansh, Bianca, and Piyush—who bring an incredible freshness and authenticity to their roles. Led by Sreeti Mukerji and shaped by the creative vision of Alia and Shaheen Bhatt, Don’t Be Shy is a joyful, heartfelt celebration of friendship, love, and the beautifully messy journey of growing up. We can’t wait for audiences to immerse themselves in Shy’s world.”
Notably, A post shared by prime video IN (@primevideoin)

As per the latest buzz, Sharing their thoughts on the movie, Alia Bhatt and Shaheen Bhatt, co-founders of Eternal Sunshine Productions, shared in a joint statement, "Don't Be Shy has been extremely special to us from the very beginning, and we couldn’t be prouder to see it come to life. What excites us most is this brilliant young cast; their energy, vulnerability, and chemistry are magnetic, and they bring such life and honesty to these characters. We can’t wait for audiences in India and around the world to meet Shy and get swept into her wonderful, chaotic world,”

In further updates, Don’t Be Shy will stream exclusively on Prime Video in Hindi with English subtitles. The movie will be available across India and more than 240 countries and territories worldwide from September 25, 2026.

title: 1942: A Love Story gets limited theatrical run after makers flag technical issues at certain cinemas
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In a statement addressed to audiences and cinema lovers, Vidhu Vinod Chopra Films shared it had received a large number of messages from viewers praising the movie's theatrical experience over the weekend. The production house explained that the movie was restored in 8K resolution with Dolby 5.1 surround sound. However, it subsequently found that some cinema halls were not technically equipped to project the restoration in its intended quality.

Adding to this, The makers have therefore decided to limit the theatrical run to "handpicked theatres" that meet the required technical standards. The production house shared it does not want to compromise on the quality of the restoration and wants audiences to experience the movie "at its absolute best." Viewers have also been asked to check the updated cinema list to find the participating theatres in their city.

Meanwhile, The restoration of 1942: A Love Story was carried out over nearly two years in Bologna, Italy, and at Prasad Movie Labs. According to the production house, more than 150 people worked on the restoration, contributing over 9,000 human hours to the project. The iconic soundtrack alone as per reports required more than 300 hours of work from the restoration team to remaster it.

Notably, The filmmakers also noted that while India currently has 4K cinemas, the restoration has been created with future viewing in mind, allowing audiences to revisit the movie in high quality in the years to come.

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Vidhu Vinod Chopra, 1942: A Love Story stars Anil Kapoor, Manisha Koirala, Jackie Shroff and Anupam Kher in pivotal roles. The movie is produced by Vidhu Vinod Chopra, with music composed by R. D. Burman and lyrics written by Javed Akhtar.

title: SCOOP: Jio Studios backs out of Brahmastra 2; Ayan Mukerji begins hunt for a new studio partner for Ranbir Kapoor-Deepika Padukone-Alia Bhatt starrer
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “Ayan Mukerji’s production house, Starlight Pictures Private Limited, was one of the producers of Brahmastra ’s first part and the banner holds the rights to the movie’s IP. Starlight will be producing Brahmastra 2 and they are looking at a studio partner to come on board.”

Adding to this, The source continued, “The makers were in discussions with Jio Studios to come on board as the studio partner for Brahmastra 2 . However, those talks did not materialise and Jio has now decided against associating with the sequel. Interestingly, Star Studios was one of the key partners on the first Brahmastra . With Star’s entertainment business now part of JioStar, and Jio Studios also operating under the larger ecosystem, there was an expectation that the association could continue with the franchise. However, as things stand, neither Jio Studios nor Star Studios is involved with Brahmastra 2 .”

Meanwhile, The source further revealed, “Dharma Productions, which also produced the first Brahmastra , is also not associated with the second instalment. After Dharma stepped away, Ayan Mukerji initiated discussions with Yash Raj Films (YRF). Aditya Chopra had shown interest in the project, particularly when Ayan was directing War 2 for YRF. However, following the disappointing performance of War 2 , YRF decided not to take the discussions forward. Jio Studios subsequently entered the picture, but that association too has not worked out. As a result, the makers are once again looking for the right studio partner for Brahmastra 2 .”

Notably, The search for a studio partner continues, though members of the trade believe that a project of this scale should not remain without one for long. An industry insider remarked, “ Brahmastra was a major theatrical success and the franchise continues to enjoy tremendous recall among audiences. More importantly, the second part is expected to feature Ranbir Kapoor and Deepika Padukone in leading roles, along with Alia Bhatt in an extended special appearance. That combination itself makes Brahmastra 2 one of the most high-profile Hindi films in development. There will naturally be considerable interest around the movie, and if mounted on the right scale, it has all the ingredients for a huge opening. So, despite the recent developments, Ayan and his team should have no shortage of potential studio partners to speak with.”

title: Arshad Warsi starrer Jeevan Bheema Yojana locks September 4 release
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Directed by Abhishek Dogra, the dark comedy features Warsi in his first double role, alongside Sanjeeda Shaikh, Vijay Raaz and others.

Adding to this, The movie was earlier scheduled to hit theatres on August 28. The makers have now verified September 4 as the final theatrical rollout date, as the movie enters the final phase of its promotional campaign. A new poster announcing the rollout date has also been unveiled.

Meanwhile, Directed by Abhishek Dogra, Jeevan Bheema Yojana features Arshad Warsi in two contrasting roles — Jeevan and Bheema. The cast also includes Sanjeeda Shaikh, Vijay Raaz, Pooja Chopra, Bijendra Kala and the late Atul Parchure.

Notably, Presented and produced by Starbeam Ventures Limited (formerly Blue God Entertainment Limited), the movie blends dark comedy, crime and suspense against the backdrop of an unusual case of mistaken identity.

As per the latest buzz, The story revolves around Jeevan, a debt-ridden common man whose life changes after he encounters his dangerous lookalike, Bheema. What initially seems like an opportunity soon turns into a series of chaotic events, pushing the characters into a complicated web of lies, greed and risky decisions.

In further updates, Talking about the movie, director Abhishek Dogra shared, “Jeevan Bheema Yojana is a movie about ordinary people making one extraordinary, catastrophic decision and then spending the rest of the movie paying for it. The genre is dark comedy, but the heart of it is very human. Arshad brings both men to life with a precision that constantly surprised us on set.”
On top of that, The movie marks a first for Arshad Warsi, who plays two distinctly different characters in the same project.
With its rollout date now verified, Jeevan Bheema Yojana is set to arrive in cinemas worldwide on September 4, 2026, bringing together dark humour, crime, suspense and mistaken identity.

title: ‘12th pass’ Kangana Ranaut shares video comparing her better English skills than Boston-graduate Abhijeet Dipke
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut has put up a post about Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke over his English speaking skills. The star took to her Instagram Stories to share a post which directly compared how the two of them spoke publicly in the English language.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut compared her English speaking skills with CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke. What Kangana shared In the reel, Abhijeet was seen giving a public statement in English in the beginning. The reel then shifted to show Kangana giving a speech in English on how she was perceived as a female star in the movie industry. The caption on the reel read: ‘12th pass Kangana Ranaut vs Boston University CJP Dipke English level: One is fire, the other needs a reboot.’

Meanwhile, Kangana has been open about how she was not fluent in English when she started her journey in the movie industry. She had shared that it was in Koffee With Karan where Sonam Kapoor had mocked her for her English. She shared, “What I learned from years of fights with movie mafia is that no outsider will ever be mocked for not speaking English…also that show is officially closed forever.”

Notably, She further added, “Please don't miss my comeback in the end. Even at 24 after being openly bullied, humiliated and mocked I showed grace sophistication articulation and humility which English speaking gossipy aunties with so called great upbringing can never…”

title: Exclusive | Abhishek Banerjee steps down from casting company: To avoid conflict of interest; questions were raised…
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
After spending around a decade balancing acting with running Casting Bay, star Abhishek Banerjee has decided to retire. Only from the casting duties, that is.

Adding to this, Abhishek Banerjee In an Instagram post on Monday, the announcement made it clear. Talking to HT City, he says the decision was “difficult”. Abhishek and Anmol Ahuja had started the company together a decade back.

Meanwhile, “I think it was any which way very difficult for me to handle any kind of company work and administrative work because of my shooting schedules,” he says. Casting, he adds, is not something he believes can be done remotely, “I don't believe in doing casting without being in the casting rooms. So for me that was very important.”

Notably, View this post on Instagram Banerjee felt he was no longer able to give the company his best, which prompted him to part ways. It is a complete separation from Casting Bay, he confirms, “I thought if I am not able to give hundred percent in something, then what's the whole point of doing it? It's better to let the youngsters take over and let them do the job.”

As per the latest buzz, The decision also came with a concern: the conflict between his two professional identities. Banerjee says he felt it was important to draw a line between his work as an star and his work as a casting director. “Because I am an star and then a casting director. These questions have been raised since I became an star,” he says. While he points out that there were “hardly any projects” where his acting and casting duties coincided, he felt it was better to remove the ambiguity. “But still I felt that let's avoid the conflict of interest," he adds.

In further updates, Banerjee makes it clear that leaving Casting Bay does not mean abandoning casting altogether. “I'm not saying that I won't do anything in casting. Maybe in the future I'll be planning something, but not as a casting director for sure,” he says. Instead, he wants to help make the profession “a more organized platform, a more democratic platform” and remain available to the casting fraternity.

On top of that, Banerjee's acting career started with small roles but soon expanded to Go Goa Gone, Stree, Dream Girl and its sequel. On OTT too, he has been part of acclaimed projects including Mirzapur, Paatal Lok and The Family Man. Mirzapur The Movie will be his immediate next.

“I want to put more focus on other stuff, and offline. I want to write, I want to produce. So I want to focus there. Hence this was my next step. It's just like sometimes you have to move on from some place to reach somewhere else," Abhishek ends.

title: Mirzapur actor Anangsha Biswas recalls getting vulgar, disturbing messages after Season 1: 'I was shaken'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mirzapur star Anangsha Biswas , who plays the role of Zarina in the web series, will be returning as her character in the much-anticipated Mirzapur : The Movie. Anangsha plays a grey character in the franchise, who uses her sex appeal to get ahead in the ruthless political world of Mirzapur. While Anangsha portrayed her character convincingly, she of late opened up that the same role that collected her appreciation also brought unwanted attention, with the star facing lewd comments and inappropriate messages.

Adding to this, Anangsha Biswas spoke about playing Zarina in Mirzapur. Mirzapur star recalls getting vulgar emails In conversation with Hindi Rush, Anangsha shared that she was deeply disturbed after the rollout of Mirzapur Season 1 as she started receiving inappropriate emails, with several people approaching her in an inappropriate manner.

Meanwhile, She shared in Hindi, "After Season 1, I was very disturbed because it was all very new to me. There were comments, strange emails and people commenting on my social media, with the same kind of words being used everywhere. I was a little shaken. I thought my work was my Saraswati and I had done it with complete dedication, so why were people saying these things."

Notably, She shared that many people assumed she was like her character in real life as well, which resulted in her receiving deeply uncomfortable emails and messages. "People asked, 'How much would you charge for one night? Come with us to Mauritius for two days, for a weekend." she shared. She added that such messages had filled her inbox.

As per the latest buzz, The star emphasised that this mindset needs to change and that people should learn to separate an star from the characters they portray on screen, especially if they play a bold and grey character.

In further updates, While films being adapted into web series have become common, it is relatively rare for a successful web show to make its way to the big screen. Mirzapur: The Movie continues the story from Season 1 of the popular series and brings together some of the franchise's most beloved and iconic characters, including Kaleen Bhaiya, Munna Bhaiya and Guddu Pandit.

On top of that, Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Divyenndu and Rasika Dugal are all returning to reprise their respective roles. The character of Bablu Pandit, originally played by Vikrant Massey in the series, will be portrayed by Jitendra Kumar in the movie.

At the movie's trailer launch, Farhan Akhtar, co-producer of the web show and the movie, admitted that the movie had been made following strong demand from followers. He shared, “The show is a result of followers' love. They have supported the show from the time it was first rolled out. Amazon took it across the world. Wherever I used to go, people used to ask me, 'Ki Mirzapur kab aa rha hai?' When it was revealed, people used to ask me the rollout date, so it is really the followers that have demanded this movie. We are very happy and grateful to have put it together with the original cast and the amazing new cast.”

title: ‘How do they explain this?’: Dipke has another question on CJP Jantar Mantar protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke on Monday shared that he spoke to two alleged victims of pellet gun fire from the July 20 parliament march, asking the police and the government to explain their injuries.

Adding to this, Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke shared that Sahil told him that he had appeared for the Delhi Police exam in 2025, which he alleged was leaked. (HFILE PHOTO) Dipke claimed that both protesters were agitating peacefully during the CJP’s Jantar Mantar protest, when they were “hit by pellets fired by the police”.

Meanwhile, “Spoke to Sahil and Vikas, two victims of pellet-gun injuries from 20 July. The police and the govt deny brutality, but how do they explain this? Sahil and Vikas were protesting peacefully when they were hit by pellets fired by the police,” Dipke wrote on X.
Notably, Dipke shared that Sahil told him that he had appeared for the Delhi Police exam in 2025, which he alleged was leaked.

As per the latest buzz, “He is a political science student and used to work part-time to support his family of five, as his father has a disability. He says there are still pellets lodged in his eye, and he has lost vision in one eye. He is now unable to work and support his family. If this is not brutality, can the govt explain what is?” he further wrote.

In further updates, Police on Friday lodged a first information report (FIR) against unknown people on a complaint by Sahil, a Delhi University student with pellet injuries during the July 20 protests, after Congress leader Rahul Gandhi accompanied the 19-year-old and sat in protest outside a police station for more than six hours.

On top of that, HT has earlier reported three other alleged cases of pellet-like injuries received by Sheikh Irshad Mansuri, a 25-year-old employee at a private firm; Sahil Lochab, a student aspiring to join the police force; and a 28-year-old reporter who did not wish to be named.
Prashant, a 25-year-old Bihar resident who spoke to Dipke, had earlier told HT that he thought he would lose his arm after allegedly suffering pellet injuries on July 20.

title: Delhi student protests: SC says no to separate probe into sexual assault charges
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Supreme Court on Monday clarified that there was no need to initiate separate suo motu proceedings to examine allegations of sexual assault against women protesters during the July 20 student protests in the national capital, as the issue has been referred to and prioritised by a five-member committee headed by its former judge R Subhash Reddy.

Adding to this, The HPEC was constituted to conduct an independent and impartial inquiry into competing allegations. (ANI) A bench, comprising Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana, shared that the high-powered enquiry committee (HPEC), constituted last week to conduct an independent inquiry into allegations of violence during the protests, had specifically been directed to examine complaints of targeted violence, harassment, molestation and secondary victimisation of women protesters on priority.
Meanwhile, The clarification came after senior advocate Shobha Gupta urged the bench to take suo motu cognisance of alleged sexual assault of women protesters during the protests held on July 20.

Notably, Gupta submitted that there were widely reported allegations of women being molested and sexually assaulted by police personnel and sought a separate mechanism for investigating the complaints.

As per the latest buzz, The bench pointed to its August 18 order constituting the HPEC and shared the issue had been specifically entrusted to the committee. The CJI shared that the committee had been asked to examine the allegations on a priority basis and submit an interim report at the earliest.
In further updates, The bench pointed out that the committee chairperson had been empowered to appoint nodal officers, following which the procedure for submitting complaints would be notified.

On top of that, The HPEC was constituted to conduct an independent and impartial inquiry into competing allegations arising from the July 20 student protest—petitions alleging excessive force by police as well as pleas concerning violence against police personnel and legality of the protest.

Other members of the committee include Justice (retired) Ravi Shankar Jha, former chief justice of the Punjab and Haryana high court, Justice (retired) Shalinder Kaur, former Delhi high court judge, Rishi Kumar Shukla, former Central Bureau of Investigation director, and LR Bishnoi, retired director general of police, Meghalaya.

title: UDF announces one-day hunger strike over Centre's railway bifurcation move in Kerala
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

United Democratic Front (UDF) MPs from Kerala have revealed a day-long hunger strike on August 26 (Thiruvonam day) in front of the Palakkad divisional railway headquarters to protest the Railways’ move to bifurcate Mangaluru railway station from Palakkad division and merge it with Mysuru division of South Western Railway.

Adding to this, Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan shared people in his constituency would be the worst affected by the decision. (ANI) The Railway Board’s decision has triggered protests in Kerala, with a section of leaders and activists alleging that it will lead to revenue loss for the division and hinder future innovation and development projects.
Meanwhile, Mangaluru Junction, from where several prominent trains to Kerala originate and terminate, is near the Kerala-Karnataka border and is a key railway hub in the region.
Notably, Kasaragod MP Rajmohan Unnithan shared people in his constituency would be the worst affected by the decision.

As per the latest buzz, “We cannot accept this decision. We have sent an email to the Railway authorities in Delhi asking to reverse the decision. The hunger strike will be the first stage of the protest. If there is no result, we will stage a protest march in Delhi,” shared Unnithan.
In further updates, The Congress MP claimed that even the Union railway minister was unaware of the move.
On top of that, “Who issued this order without the knowledge of the Railway Minister and the officials of the Southern Railway in Chennai ?” he asked.
He shared the Palakkad division relies heavily on freight movement through Mangaluru port. “We are going to lose around ₹ 600 crore rupees through this,” he shared.

title: CINTAA head Poonam Dhillon responds to Upasana Singh's allegations: 'Every penny raised is fully accounted for'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Cine and TV Artistes Association ( CINTAA ) General Secretary Upasana Singh accused CINTAA President Poonam Dhillon and Senior Vice President Padmini Kolhapure of "dictatorship" amid allegations of prolonged tensions over the functioning of the association. Now, Poonam has responded to Upasana's allegations at a recent press conference.

Adding to this, Poonam Dhillon and Padmini Kolhapure. 'Every penny raised is fully accounted for' As per a report in Deccan Chronicle, Poonam Dhillon defended her stance and addressed the allegations of financial irregularities. She shared, ”Upasana Singh’s allegations are completely baseless and false. Every penny raised is fully accounted for and reaches its rightful beneficiary. Not a single rupee is used for personal gain. We have zero tolerance for anything illegal or unconstitutional. Our work stands on transparency, accountability and facts and the records speak for themselves”

Meanwhile, Padmini Kolhapure also dismissed Upasana's allegations as untrue and shared, ”The allegations made by Upasana Singh are entirely untrue and without basis. The funds we raise are handled with utmost responsibility and are directed to the people and causes they are meant for. They are never diverted for our personal use. We have always maintained a strict stand against anything unlawful or unconstitutional. Our only priority is to ensure that the purpose behind every contribution is honoured with complete integrity.”

Notably, Earlier this month, 11 members of the 21-member Executive Committee resigned from CINTAA and called for fresh elections. The resignations were submitted to Upasana, and she accepted them in her capacity as General Secretary.

As per the latest buzz, The members had alleged that decision-making had increasingly come into the hands of CINTAA President Poonam Dhillon and Senior VP Padmini Kolhapure, along with some other members of the Executive Committee. The members also alleged that Dhillon had taken several key decisions independently, including communicating with government officials through her personal ID and deciding on communications with industry bodies through the association's official ID.

In further updates, In conversation with Hindustan Times, Upasana had shared that one of the key disagreements had been over the manner in which disciplinary action was allegedly being taken against artistes. She claimed that those who were not "yes ma'am" were issued show-cause notices.

On top of that, She also shared that, according to CINTAA's constitution, the resignation of at least half of the committee leads to its dissolution and fresh elections. However, she claimed that Poonam and her associates had not resigned. “Our constitution says that if more than half of the people resign, or even 50% resign, then our committee breaks down and re-election is revealed. This is our constitution,” she shared.

Upasana also pointed out that the association held an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) despite the committee having already been dissolved, further adding to the ongoing dispute over the functioning of CINTAA.

title: Why CJP is threatening another march: FIRs, NEET compensation among 3 pending demands
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) will hold a crucial National Working Committee meeting on Monday, August 24 to review the status of assurances given by the Centre that led the party to call off its nationwide agitation last month. With the party alleging that several commitments remain unfulfilled, the meeting will consider all options, including another peaceful nationwide agitation.

Adding to this, CJP leaders and student protesters at Jantar Mantar during the protest over NEET paper leak. (Sanchit Khanna/HT) The CJP has particularly raised concerns over the lack of progress on three key assurances: withdrawal or quashing of FIRs registered against students and protesters, a guarantee that students and peaceful protesters will not face punitive action, and compensation for the families of deceased NEET victims.

Meanwhile, The party shared the government delegation that held talks with the CJP has not formally communicated the steps being taken to fulfil these commitments. It has warned that any attempt to "dilute, delay, reinterpret or dishonour" the assurances would amount to "vishwasghaat" (betrayal) of the country's youth.
Notably, The CJP's primary demand is the withdrawal or quashing of FIRs registered against students and protesters in connection with the protests.

As per the latest buzz, The issue came up before the Supreme Court on August 18, when the court asked the Union government three separate times to provide a consolidated list of FIRs registered against students and protesters across the country.
In further updates, According to the CJP, the list would have allowed the Supreme Court to consider using its extraordinary powers under Article 142 of the Constitution to quash the cases together.

On top of that, However, the party shared the Centre did not commit to providing the list despite the court repeatedly seeking it. The CJP has cited this as a major concern over whether the assurance on FIRs is being implemented.
The CJP also says the Centre had committed that no student or peaceful protester would face punitive action in the future.

title: 3 mowed down on Del-Mum Expressway; protest triggers traffic jam over 20 km
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Angry residents blocked the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway and triggered a traffic jam stretching around 20 km on both sides, leaving thousands of commuters stranded, after a speeding car hit and killed three women mowing the grass on the expressway median at Jamwaramgarh in Rajasthan’s Jaipur district on Sunday evening. Jamwaramgarh residents protested, even as the driver abandoned the car about a kilometre from the accident site and fled.

Adding to this, The driver abandoned the car about a kilometre from the accident site and fled. (REPRESENTATIVE IMAGE) Police rushed the three women to a hospital, where two were declared dead. The third died during treatment. Rajendra Kumar, a Rajasthan Police officer, identified the three as Prem Devi, 55, Manfuli Devi, 50 and Kaushalya Devi, 45.
Meanwhile, Police shared the three were part of a five-woman group mowing grass. Two were working inside the median railing, while the three were outside when the speeding car hit them.

Notably, Ruling Bharatiya Janata Party’s Rajasthan unit chief Madan Rathore and former legislator Gyandev Ahuja, who were travelling from Delhi to Jaipur , were among those caught in the traffic jam. Rathore spoke to top officials, following which police teams were rushed to pacify the protesters from Jamwaramgarh, Kanota and Andhi.

As per the latest buzz, Police attempted to escort Rathore through the traffic jam, but the protesters surrounded him and demanded compensation of ₹ 20 lakh each for the families of the three. The blockade was lifted after the administration revealed compensation of ₹ 17 lakh each, along with a contractual job for one member of each family and dairy booths for the three families. Police shared they were looking for the driver.

title: Ajay Devgn announces Drishyam 3 title Drishyam The Conclusion, returns as Vijay Salgaonkar for final chapter
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ajay Devgn is returning as Vijay Salgaonkar for the third and final movie in the Hindi Drishyam franchise. The star has revealed the official title of the third installment, Drishyam The Conclusion, which is set to rollout in theatres on October 2, 2026. After two films filled with twists, secrets and Vijay’s carefully thought-out moves to keep his family safe, the franchise is now gearing up to reveal how his story finally comes to an end.

Adding to this, Ajay Devgn’s Drishyam 3 is officially titled The Conclusion; movie releases on October 2, 2026. Ajay makes the announcement On August 24, Ajay Devgn unveiled the first poster of Drishyam The Conclusion, officially announcing the final chapter of the franchise. The poster features the line, "Mera Sach, Mera Sahi, Sirf Meri Family Hai" (My truth, my right, only my family hai), perfectly capturing Vijay Salgaonkar’s mindset.

Meanwhile, The first-look teaser had already hinted at what lies ahead, with Ajay's voiceover giving followers a glimpse into Vijay's state of mind. Rolled out in December 2025, he is heard saying, “The world calls me by many names — criminal, murderer,deceitful,cunning, fraud,cunning, hero, innocent, father, and mastermind. But it doesn’t matter to me. Because I understood one thing from whatever happened, whatever I did, saw, or showed in the past seven years: In this world, every person’s truth is different, as are their rights. My truth and right are my family. As long as things don’t stop, as long as others don’t fail, I will stand here, like agatekeeper and a wall.”

Notably, Drishyam The Conclusion is backed by Star Studio18 and Panorama Studios, with Abhishek Pathak returning to direct the third instalment. He has also co-written the movie with Aamil Keeyan Khan and Parveez Shaikh. Alok Jain, Ajit Andhare, Kumar Mangat Pathak and Abhishek Pathak are producing the movie.

As per the latest buzz, The movie followed Vijay Salgaonkar, a mild-mannered family man from Goa who uses his wits to help his family escape the clutches of the law after a murder occurs in their house.

In further updates, The third installment will see Ajay Devgn return as Vijay Salgaonkar, with Tabu reprising her role as IG Meera Deshmukh and Shriya Saran back as Nandini. Rajat Kapoor will also return, while Prakash Raj and Jaideep Ahlawat have joined the cast in new roles. The shoot has been completed and the movie is currently in post-production.

On top of that, The Hindi Drishyam franchise began in 2015 with the remake of Mohanlal’s Malayalam thriller. The movie quickly won over audiences and went on to collect around ₹ 110 crore rupees worldwide, making Vijay Salgaonkar a fan-favourite. Drishyam 2, which arrived in 2022, took the franchise a step further and turned out to be an even bigger hit, grossing nearly ₹ 342 crore rupees worldwide.

While the Hindi franchise is set to wrap up Vijay Salgaonkar’s story, the original Malayalam series is showing no signs of slowing down. Mohanlal and Jeethu Joseph’s Drishyam 3 hit theatres on May 21, 2026, and turned out to be another big success for the franchise. The movie opened worldwide with around ₹ 43.37 crore rupees and went on to cross ₹ 242 crore rupees globally, making it the highest-grossing instalment in the Drishyam series so far.

title: Harshvardhan Rane compares career to stocks, credits opportunities for renewed career momentum
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Mumbai, Harshvardhan Rane shared an star's position in the movie industry is tied to their box-office, and that it mirrors how a stock's value fluctuates based on market sentiment.

Adding to this, Harshvardhan Rane compares career to stocks, credits opportunities for renewed career momentum Rane, whose 2016 romantic drama "Sanam Teri Kasam" gained renewed popularity after its theatrical re-rollout in 2025, shared he does not take it personally when the industry overlooks him and instead sees it as motivation to work harder.

Meanwhile, "The stock of gold has risen after three to four months, and life is like stocks; when the stocks are rising, it is very mathematical. I don't hold it personally . If you ignore me tomorrow, I'll work harder, and if you give me more work, I'll work even harder.
Notably, "I value and respect the opportunities given to me and even if I'm not getting the opportunities, it adds to my determination to do some more work," the star told PTI in an interview.

As per the latest buzz, Rane started his career with the television show "Left Right Left" and later appeared in Telugu and Hindi films like "Thakita Thakita", "Naa Ishtam", "Haseen Dillruba", and "Tara vs Bilal", among others. But he tasted success in 2025 with the re-rollout of "Sanam Teri Kasam" and director Milap Zaveri's "Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat".

In further updates, He is thrilled about the opportunity to work with his mentor-star John Abraham in "Force 3", in which he will be seen as an antagonist, filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma's "Daya Nayak". He has also completed work on Omung Kumar's "Sailaab", a romance-action movie.
On top of that, Reflecting on his association with Abraham, the star recalled he had once delivered a helmet to the star in 2004 and now finds himself sharing the screen with him in "Force 3".

"When people say that Chat GPT and Claude and all the AI apps are taking over, I challenge you, if you ask for the weirdest full story, they won't be able to write something as wild as this," he shared.

title: Kunal Kohli urges Tukaram Mundhe to raid Indian household kitchens: ‘There will be expired items from years ago’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe is currently one of the most celebrated and talked-about IAS officers in the country. Following his surprise raids at several food outlets across Maharashtra, many have even compared him to Anil Kapoor's character from Nayak . Now, filmmaker Kunal Kohli has asked the food safety officer to extend his crackdown to Indian household kitchens as well.

Adding to this, Kunal Kohli makes a hilarious appeal to FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe. Kunal Kohli requests Tukaram Mundhe to raid household kitchens In his latest Instagram post, Kunal Kohli shared a message for Tukaram Mundhe. The filmmaker jokingly suggested that the IAS officer should raid kitchens across Indian households, as he is likely to find expired products in most kitchens.

Meanwhile, He wrote, “I request Tukaram Munde to raid kitchen shelves & refrigerators in Indian Households across the country. There will be expired items, from years ago, neatly & safely preserved, the bottles & packets wiped clean every month & put back on the shelf or refrigerator never to be used again."

Notably, Kunal then suggested that everyone should carry out a ‘Tukaram Munde cleaning’ of their homes themselves. He added, “Chalo let's do a Tukaram Munde cleaning of our kitchen shelves & refrigerator. #tukarammunde @tukaram_ias.”

As per the latest buzz, Kunal's statement comes at a time when the Maharashtra FDA is inspecting places where food is prepared and sold, including restaurants, hotels, roadside eateries and other food establishments across the state.

In further updates, As part of the ongoing raids, the department has suspended the licences of several well-known eateries in Mumbai. The inspections have also covered establishments that supply food through online delivery platforms, with action being taken against some of them after expired products and other lapses were found.

On top of that, The FDA's inspections have brought renewed attention to food safety and hygiene standards at eateries and other establishments. The department has been conducting checks to identify violations and take action wherever food safety norms are found to have been flouted.

The FDA has shared that the campaign could amount to surrogate or indirect promotion of prohibited pan masala or tobacco-related products. The show-cause notices give the actors 15 days from the date of receipt to submit a written explanation.

title: Awarapan 2 box office collection day 10: Emraan Hashmi’s sequel races past ₹136 crore in second weekend
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Awarapan 2 ticket-window earnings day 10: Awarapan 2 is holding strong at the ticket-window even after completing ten days in theatres. Emraan Hashmi ’s sequel, which rolled out on August 14 alongside Sunny Deol’s Batwara 1947 , has managed to stay ahead of its competition and is continuing to draw audiences in its second week. With steady footfalls and strong word-of-mouth working in its favour, Awarapan 2 has turned out to be one of the year’s notable theatrical performers so far.

Adding to this, Awarapan 2 ticket-window earnings day 10: Emraan Hashmi sequel nears ₹140 crore rupees net, closes in on ₹200 crore rupees worldwide. Awarapan 2 ticket-window earnings According to trade trade tracker Sacnilk, Awarapan 2 continued its strong run on the second Sunday, collecting ₹ 8.75 crore rupees net in India on Day 10. The movie recorded around 21% occupancy across 13,632 shows, taking its total India net collection to ₹ 136.25 crore rupees. Its India gross now stands at ₹ 162.50 crore rupees.

Meanwhile, The movie also collected ₹ 1.50 crore rupees from overseas markets on Day 10, pushing its overseas gross to ₹ 30.30 crore rupees. With this, Awarapan 2 has reached ₹ 192.80 crore rupees worldwide and is now less than ₹ 8 crore rupees away from the ₹ 200 crore rupees milestone.

Notably, The second weekend brought another boost for Awarapan 2 after a slightly slower Friday. The movie, which had ended its first week at ₹ 113.50 crore rupees net, added ₹ 5.75 crore rupees on its second Friday from 9,858 shows. Saturday saw a clear jump as the movie collected ₹ 8.25 crore rupees net, up 43.5% from Friday, across 10,008 shows. Overall occupancy stood at 18%, while evening and night shows recorded much stronger footfalls, with occupancy going up to 33.85%.

As per the latest buzz, Awarapan 2 got off to a strong start, earning ₹ 22 crore rupees net on its opening day. The movie picked up pace on Independence Day, with collections jumping 53.4% to ₹ 33.75 crore rupees net on Day 2, which remains its highest single-day collection so far.

In further updates, The movie continued its strong run on Day 3, adding another ₹ 26 crore rupees net. This took its opening weekend total to ₹ 81.75 crore rupees. Awarapan 2 maintained its momentum through the week and ended its first seven days with ₹ 113.50 crore rupees net in India, comfortably crossing the ₹ 100 crore rupees mark in its opening week.

On top of that, Directed by Nitin Kakkar and produced by Vishesh Bhatt, Awarapan 2 brings Emraan Hashmi back as Shivam Pandit. The movie also features Disha Patani and Shabana Azmi in key roles, with Puran Gabbi, Anirudh Rawal, Surendar Vicky, Vijayant Kohli and Atul Kumar rounding out the cast.

title: Fissures emerge between Left and TVK over Tamil Nadu’s anti-protest circular
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Fissures emerged between the Left parties and the ruling Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam ( TVK ) in Tamil Nadu after Communist Party of India (Marxist) state secretary P Shanmugam questioned whether the chief minister C Joseph Vijay -led government intends to stay in power with the support of Left parties or by using administrative officers.

Adding to this, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay, CPI(M) Tamil Nadu state secretary P Shanmugam and senior party leaders (PTI) His remarks come in the backdrop of protests led by the Left parties on Saturday over a circular aimed at profiling students participating in political protests without permission. It was however withdrawn by the Directorate of Collegiate Education later.

Meanwhile, Similarly, another circular was also issued by the Gujiliamparai tehsildar M Ayyasamy in Dindigul district instructing revenue inspectors and village assistants to collect the details of Left parties present in the region. The Dindigul district collector also withdrew the circular after backlash.
Notably, Shanmugam raised objections that the circulars were issued after the chief secretary M Sai Kumar held a meeting at the Secretariat on July 28.

As per the latest buzz, In a video statement, Shanmugam shared, “The CPI(M) and CPI have given support for this government to be formed and to continue in power... Doesn’t the chief secretary know this? Don’t the tehsildar and the district collector know this?”

In further updates, He added, “...if reports and circulars are sent with such ulterior motives targeting the Left, are you going to run the government with them (administrative officers), or are you going to continue the government with the Left??”
On top of that, Criticising the government, he shared, “...This action cannot be tolerated. This issue must be resolved amicably and peacefully in a way that puts a permanent full stop to this.”

Responding to the development, TVK deputy general secretary and minister CTR Nirmal Kumar shared the concerned tehsildar who issued such a circular on his own and action has been taken against him on the matter.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Veteran star and mimicry artist Aasha Singh Jaiswal has passed away in Mumbai. She died on August 22, with her son Akkash Bharadwaj confirming the news. A familiar face in films and television, Aasha was also known for her mimicry performances. According to Akkash, she passed away at around 7:30 pm. Her last rites were held the next morning at the Pawan Hans Crematorium in Vile Parle West, Mumbai.

Adding to this, Veteran star Aasha Singh Jaiswal passes away in Mumbai; son remembers her as an ‘Iron Lady’. Aasha Singh Jaiswal’s son pays tribute to her Remembering his mother, Akkash posted on Instagram to honour her life and her dedication to her work. He described her as an “Iron Lady” and urged people to continue watching and remembering her performances.

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram “Wah ek karmath Loh-Mahila (Iron Lady) thi. Aap sabhi unki aatma ki sadgati evam shanti ke liye prarthna karen. Aur unke kaam ko social media par zarur dekhen aur yaad rakhen taaki unki aatma jahan bhi hon prasanchitt ho ki aap unka kaam ab bhi dekh aur yaad kar rahen hain (She was a dedicated ‘Iron Lady’. Please pray for the peace and salvation of her soul. title: Anushka Ranjan and Aditya Seal welcome twin baby girls, reveal their adorable names
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Student of the Year 2 star Aditya Seal and his wife Anushka Ranjan are now parents, and they have twice the reason to celebrate. The couple has welcomed twin baby girls and shared the happy news with their followers on social media. They also introduced their daughters by revealing their names, making the announcement even more special.

Adding to this, Akansha Ranjan and Aditya Seal have become parents for the first time and welcomed twin baby girls. Anushka and Aditya welcome twin baby girls Anushka Ranjan and Aditya Seal are now parents to twin baby girls, who were born on August 23, 2026. The couple shared the news with their followers on social media, introducing their daughters as Vira Ranjan Seal and Mahi Ranjan Seal.

Meanwhile, The announcement came with an adorable card featuring illustrations of the two little girls. Calling themselves a “very excited” family, Anushka and Aditya shared their happiness and gratitude as they welcomed their daughters. Aditya posted on Instagram to a pen a brief note which read, “My sunshines are here to brighten our lives ♥️♥️ Our hearts are full of love and gratitude. Vira ♾️ Mahi #TeamGirl ♥️♥️.”

Notably, View this post on Instagram Anushka Ranjan and Aditya Seal's journey to parenthood The couple had revealed Anushka's pregnancy earlier this year through a series of beautiful maternity pictures. The post marked the beginning of an exciting journey for Anushka and Aditya, who shared their happiness about welcoming a new member to their family.

As per the latest buzz, Back in May 2026, the couple spoke about the pregnancy to HT City . Anushka told HT City, “We are a little late in sharing the news as the baby is set to arrive in September. We wanted to give ourselves some time, hence the delay. Also, it has been an overwhelming moment for us to share the news with all. I was more nervous than ever, even announcing my wedding was easier than this, but now I am at peace and relaxed, as people’s response and the way our friends reacted is so emotional for us.”

In further updates, A few months, on their YouTube channel, Anushka had opened up about her difficult IVF journey and the constant support she received from her husband, Aditya, throughout the process. “I have taken around 150 injections, minimum. Initially, Adi(tya Seal) used to administer them. I used to get very scared. They were thick and oil-based. When he used to put the needle in, I used to cry in pain. I used to see him walking to me with the injection, and I was like, ‘I just cannot deal with this anymore. I don’t know how I’m going to do this,’” she recalled.

On top of that, She had also opened up that she and Aditya had been thinking about starting a family since 2023. However, it was her sister Akansha Ranjan who encouraged her to see a doctor and seek professional advice. “You know, from childhood we are taught that if you get intimate with someone, you'll get pregnant. And it's not true. It's really not true,” she added. She further explained the chances of conceiving naturally, adding, “Your chances are only 15% every cycle to have a baby. I was shocked that we are never given this information.”

Anushka Ranjan and Aditya Seal first crossed paths on June 26, 2017, at an event organised by Anushka’s NGO, Beti. What started as a meeting eventually turned into a relationship, and after dating for a few years, the two got married in Mumbai in November 2021.

title: Several detained after 300 people gathered at Delhi's Connaught Place to protest reservation
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Multiple people were detained after around 300 protesters gathered at Connaught Place's outer circle in Delhi on Sunday to protest against caste-based reservation, officials shared. The protesters were also demanding reforms in the quota system, officials shared.

Adding to this, The agitation took place under the banner of “Reservation Hatao Andolan” – an Instagram-based page with around 5.6 million followers. (ANI) Over 20 people, who had gathered for the stir at Connaught Place, were detained and removed from the site because no permission had been granted for the agitation, police as per reports shared.

Meanwhile, The protesters, who were carrying placards, raised slogans and called for greater emphasis on economic criteria when deciding eligibility for reservation. They further shared that the assistance should reach economically disadvantaged people irrespective of caste, according to news agency PTI.
Notably, Earlier today, the Delhi Police shared no permission was granted to any individual or organisation to hold a protest or gathering at Jantar Mantar over reservation reforms.

As per the latest buzz, The gathering was cleared from the protest site, while the police maintained a presence at the Connaught Place. The agitation took place under the banner of “Reservation Hatao Andolan” – an Instagram-based page with around 5.6 million followers – which had called on its followers to join a protest in Delhi after building an online campaign around reservation reforms.
In further updates, Among the demands raised by the protesters was the introduction of a creamy-layer criterion and a review of the existing reservation framework, PTI reported.

On top of that, They also called for changes in policies concerning Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and Other Backward Classes. One of the protesters shared the stir was “not against reservation” but for “reforms in reservation”. “The government should understand that poor people from all communities also face difficulties and their concerns should be heard,” the protester told PTI.

The protesters raised concerns regarding the University Grants Commission framework and the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act. They sought a broader review of policies they shared were affecting opportunities in education and employment.

title: Shahid Kapoor's Deva co-star Rohullah Mehdi arrested in Mumbai drug case
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star and model Rohullah Mehdi, who worked alongside Shahid Kapoor in the 2025 movie Deva , has been arrested by the Kashimira Police Crime Branch in connection with an alleged drug trafficking case. According to a report by ANI, Mehdi and his associate were arrested with 28 grams of drugs.

Adding to this, Shahid Kapoor's Deva co-star Rohullah Mehdi arrested In Mumbai drugs case. Shahid Kapoor's Deva co-star arrested with 28 grams of drugs According to ANI, Maharashtra's Kashimira police arrested the star. Their tweet read, “Rohullah Mehdi, who worked alongside Bollywood star Shahid Kapoor in the movie ‘Deva,’ has been arrested in a drug trafficking case. Kashimira police officials received a tip-off that Mehdi was coming to the Dahisar Check Naka for drug trafficking. Senior Police Inspector Rajendra Kamble of the Kashimira Police Station formed a team and initiated surveillance and investigation. Rohullah Mehdi and his associate were arrested with 28 grams of drugs. Police have launched an investigation: Mira-Bhayandar Police.”

Meanwhile, As per an NDTV report, police shared Rohullah Mehdi is originally from Budgam district in Jammu and Kashmir and had been living in Goregaon, Mumbai. Besides working with Shahid Kapoor in Deva, he has also appeared in several web series.

Notably, Mehdi was produced before a court following his arrest and was sent to five days of police custody, according to the report. Police are now investigating the alleged drug network and are trying to determine who Mehdi may have supplied the drugs to.
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Rohullah Mehdi (@rohullahmehdi)

In further updates, Directed by Rosshan Andrrews and produced by Siddharth Roy Kapur under Roy Kapur Films, Deva starred Shahid Kapoor in the lead role, alongside Pooja Hegde and Pavail Gulati in pivotal roles. The movie was adapted from Andrrews' 2013 Malayalam movie Mumbai Police. The movie followed a violent police officer who undergoes a personality change after losing his memory in an accident. As he tries to piece together his past, he reinvestigates the murder of a fellow police officer. Deva received mixed reviews from critics and had an underwhelming run at the ticket-window.

title: Assam cab operators warn of protest as Meghalaya blockade continues despite talks
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Despite a high-level meeting between the governments of Assam and Meghalaya over the recent violence in Shillong, Assam cab operators who withdrew a three-day-long protest on Saturday claimed that their counterparts in Meghalaya were still blocking Assam-registered vehicles.

Adding to this, Assam cab operators prevented Meghalaya-registered vehicles from entering the state in protest against the violence that left many from their state injured and traumatised. (PTI) The vehicle owners and drivers, who called off their blockade at Jorabat on Saturday evening following an intervention by Assam minister for border protection and development departments Atul Bora, shared on Sunday that groups in Meghalaya were still blocking all Assam-registered vehicles despite the high-level talks.

Meanwhile, “They kept blocking Assam-registered vehicles till late Saturday and it continued on Sunday. We told them about the meeting but they shared they were not aware of it,” shared a cab operator, requesting anonymity, adding that he witnessed it himself.

Notably, “We temporarily called off our blockade to respect the initiatives being taken by the governments of both states but we cannot see a similar attitude from their side. If this continues, we may resume our protest,” another cab operator shared.
As per the latest buzz, The blockade in Assam’s Jorabat started on Friday in protest against alleged attacks on Assam residents and vehicles during violence in Shillong.

In further updates, The violence was triggered during a “black-flag” motorcycle rally by the Khasi Students’ Union (KSU) on Wednesday, demanding recruitment reforms and implementation of security acts. Protesters vandalised and set ablaze vehicles, including those with Assam registration numbers, and damaged a glass panel of a statue of philosopher Swami Vivekananda.

On top of that, Assam cab operators prevented Meghalaya-registered vehicles from entering the state in protest against the violence that left many from their state injured and traumatised. They alleged that Assam-registered vehicles were targeted during the KSU rally.

The blockade impacted the regular movement of vehicles between the two states. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma and his Meghalaya counterpart Conrad Sangma discussed the matter and issued a joint statement on Friday evening.

title: Hina Khan recalls first meeting Shah Rukh Khan on flight, says she waited for him to wake up for a photo: ‘Was anxious’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Many celebrities have spoken about their Shah Rukh Khan stories, especially the first time they met the superstar. Of late, TV stars Hina Khan and Abhinav Shukla also recalled the first time they met Shah Rukh and shared how graciously he interacted with them despite being tired.

Adding to this, Hina Khan spoke about meeting Shah Rukh Khan for the first time. Shah Rukh promised Hina Khan a photo, then went back to sleep While talking to Rocky Jaiswal, Rubina Dilaik and Abhinav Shukla for their podcast POV, Hina recalled the time she met Shah Rukh Khan when she was just 1.5 years into the industry. She remembered meeting him on a flight and shared, “The first time I met SRK, we were on the same flight. It had been a year and a half since my show Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai had started. I was very new in the industry. I saw him sitting next to me. I took a deep breath and saw again that he was sleeping. I couldn’t believe it. I was anxious to get a photo, but he wasn’t waking up. Somehow, he woke up for coffee."

Meanwhile, While SRK promised to get a picture with Hina, he was so tired that he went back to sleep, only to oblige her for a photo later. Sharing the same, she shared, "I waved a hi to him and asked if I could get a picture. He shared, ‘Wait, I’ll give you a photo.’ He had his coffee and went back to sleep. I kept waiting. Once we landed, I thought I missed the chance, but he got up, called me, and clicked a picture. We were also in the same coach later. He went to the last seat and slept. He was promoting some movie at the time and hadn’t slept for days."

Notably, Abhinav Shukla also recalled his first meeting with Shah Rukh Khan. He shared how the star stood up and shook his hand. He shared, “My first meeting with SRK was when I was fresh off the boat from Punjab and modelling in Mumbai. We were doing a ramp show for a watch brand, and we were backstage. We saw SRK enter; it was the first time I saw him. I decided to go and shake his hand. He was talking to his manager, then he looked at me, got up, and shook my hand. That defines the character of that man."

As per the latest buzz, Shah Rukh Khan will next be seen in King, an soon-to-release action thriller directed by Siddharth Anand. The movie also stars his daughter Suhana Khan, marking their first on-screen collaboration. The project is expected to feature Shah Rukh in a new action avatar and is currently among the most anticipated Hindi films. King is scheduled to rollout in theatres in 2026.

title: Ravi Kishan's daughter Rivva Kishan reacts to him becoming a meme sensation: ‘We keep sharing those reels’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ravi Kishan is currently the talk of the town, with the star-politician becoming a meme sensation on social media. Of late, his daughter Rivva Kishan , who also participated with him in the reality show Alliance , spoke about her reaction to Ravi Kishan's widely shared memes and how their family responds to them.

Adding to this, Ravi Kishan and daughter Rivva Kishan. 'We keep sharing those memes' During a podcast with Filmygyan, Rivva spoke about her reaction to her father Ravi Kishan becoming a meme sensation. She shared, “Of course, I am watching all of it. I love it. I am proud. We cherish it, celebrate it, and we laugh. Whenever I am doing nothing, I am exploring and finding all the possible creativity. It’s all of his hard work and the journey he has had. He has really worked hard. We only laugh while watching these memes. We keep sharing those meme reels with each other and keep laughing. Every morning, we end up talking about the memes. The conversation ends there only.”

Meanwhile, During the same interaction, Rivva Kishan addressed the nepotism debate and how many perceive that coming from a movie family makes things easier for an star. She also spoke about the failure of her debut movie Sab Kushal Mangal (2020), which also starred Akshaye Khanna.

Notably, She shared, “I am my father’s daughter. People know that they can approach, but you have to prove yourself. It takes a lot to prove yourself. My movie Sab Kushal Mangal didn’t fare as well as we thought it would, but I knew I had a lot to work on as a performer. I knew that I wasn’t as ready at that time, as much as I am today. I have no problem accepting this. No one is born with skills, you learn, explore, and then you figure it out. I am headed in the right direction now; I am still very proud of that movie.”

As per the latest buzz, Rivva also shared that amid all the criticism, her father's advice to her has been to remain real and carve her own path through hard work, skills and experience. She also suggested that star kids carry a certain pressure that people don't always see. There is a responsibility that she feels as Ravi Kishan's daughter, especially because her father has had a strong impact on audiences through his personality and performances.

In further updates, Ravi Kishan made a voluntary exit from the reality show Alliance just five days after entering the show with Rivva. He left the Kunal Kemmu-hosted show to return to Gorakhpur, citing his political responsibilities and ‘national duty’ as a Member of Parliament.

title: Exclusive| Taapsee Pannu on Kangana Ranaut controversy: One needs proper education, upbringing to understand what I said
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

B- town’s long standing feud between actors Taapsee Pannu and Kangana Ranaut reignited over the weekend. At India Today Women’s Summit, Taapsee addressed the long-standing issue. She shared that she holds no malice, has never met Kangana face-to-face, and that their vastly different worldviews simply reflect their unique upbringings. She had shared, "My opinion on her is reflective of my upbringing and my way of talking, my way of perceiving things and hers... she stands by hers. So, I think that's enough for everybody to look and decide who comes from where."

Adding to this, Taapsee Kangana interpreted the comment as a personal attack on her family and background. She posted a fiery multi-part Instagram story attacking Taapsee’s background, calling her a “cheap sasti copy” yet again, and heavily critiquing Taapsee’s soon-to-release movie. Kangana deleted her explosive stories shortly after posting them. Taapsee quickly shared a brief, cryptic post reading “Hence, proved” on her social media, widely understood by followers to be a concluding mic-drop response. Taapsee when contacted told HTCity, "I've always maintained I don't get offended by these sasti copy remarks. I've always shared I'm happy she thinks I'm a copy, and that she's a phenomenal star and I'm not. I dont come from a rich background or have the highest paid star tags, maybe I'm sasti that way. What I shared was, 'how one speaks is reflective of one's upbringing.' It's upto to that person to assume whether I shared something bad about the upbringing or something good. If you believe I am demeaning your upbringing, it means you believe you made demeaning comments. I did not say that! But then, I also think one needs proper education and upbringing to understand what I shared."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by HT City (@htcity)
